confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from scattered 2026 Bangkok menus, travel guides and cost-of-living snippets that disagree by 20-50%, converted at an assumed ~34 THB per USD. Restaurant meal and coffee anchors are the firmer ones; cocktail and wine are bounded by mid-range hotel-bar menus. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates with no accommodation search. The FX observation was not verified on an rba.gov.au page: the figure came from a search-result summary attributing 0.6976 to the RBA 4pm reference on 2026-11-03, which is about two weeks before the generation date. Treat source_rate as unverified and check the RBA F11.1 table before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Bangkok-specific food and drink basis from 2026 menus and guides, with prices converted at about 34 THB per USD. Accommodation is a holistic estimate for Bangkok's mid-range and budget segments, not based on any comparable city or live listings. Bangkok is treated as a mid-cost Southeast Asian capital.
